subject: Log the real reason for why posix_fadvise failed (#430)
reason: The change only sets errno to posix_fadvise's return code before returning -1 in reclaimFilePageCache (src/util.c), so callers log the real failure reason via strerror. The function's return value and all behavior are unchanged; the only observable effect is the wording of a log warning, and only when posix_fadvise itself fails, which cannot be triggered from a workload on a healthy local filesystem. No command reply, data, persistence or replication path changes, so no scenario can reach or judge it.
